slides.heading: Every Sunday you decide whether to change your training or your food.
Volyume is a workout and food-tracking app that makes that weekly call for you.
It reads your training and your food, and each week it says change, or hold.
Then it shows you the reason behind the call, in plain English.
Some weeks the honest answer is hold.
slides.supporting: It tells you why instead of inventing a change.

slides.heading: Volyume.
slides.supporting: Free to start on Google Play. The weekly coaching, with its food diary, is Pro.
